--- /home/user/phase16-backend/qemu-patched ---
#!/bin/bash
# Pinned Phase-15 patched QEMU 11.1.2 (TCG), launched through the private
# glibc 2.40 loader because the host glibc (2.36) predates the binary's
# GLIBC_2.38 requirement. The emulator ELF, loader and runtime libraries are
# named with absolute literals so tools/v1_guest_proof.py can hash every link
# of the launch chain separately from this wrapper. -accel tcg is added by
# the harness (arena_env.qemu_cmd), never assumed here.
HOST_LEAF="/home/user/glibc-2.40/hostleaf"
exec "/home/user/glibc-2.40/lib/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2" \
    --library-path "/home/user/glibc-2.40/lib:/home/user/phase15-pkg/backend/runtime/lib:/home/user/glibc-2.40/hostleaf" \
    "/home/user/phase15-pkg/backend/qemu-system-x86_64-patched" \
    -L "/home/user/phase15-pkg/backend/pc-bios" "$@"
--- /home/user/phase16-backend/qemu-unpatched ---
#!/bin/bash
# Pinned Phase-15 patched QEMU 11.1.2 (TCG), launched through the private
# glibc 2.40 loader because the host glibc (2.36) predates the binary's
# GLIBC_2.38 requirement. The emulator ELF, loader and runtime libraries are
# named with absolute literals so tools/v1_guest_proof.py can hash every link
# of the launch chain separately from this wrapper. -accel tcg is added by
# the harness (arena_env.qemu_cmd), never assumed here.
HOST_LEAF="/home/user/glibc-2.40/hostleaf"
exec "/home/user/glibc-2.40/lib/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2" \
    --library-path "/home/user/glibc-2.40/lib:/home/user/phase15-pkg/backend/runtime/lib:/home/user/glibc-2.40/hostleaf" \
    "/home/user/phase15-pkg/backend/qemu-system-x86_64-unpatched" \
    -L "/home/user/phase15-pkg/backend/pc-bios" "$@"
